title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, September 28, 1895, page 6

facts.fact: Allen ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening

notes: The item is a short paid-style notice; the whole notice is about Allen, so focus primary. Same notice appears in 917 and 920.
